openDecisions.question: Container width at which the two book fields switch from one column to two
openDecisions.specRef: 01_TASK A 4A; C 'Responsive to form content width'
openDecisions.facts: Book group width = section inner width. With the nav sidebar expanded (16rem, shows at lg, sidebar.tsx:25, :121; use-mobile.ts:3) and the 22rem right column (character-edit-page.tsx:299): 1024px viewport -> ~246px (sm:grid-cols-2 would give two ~115px columns), 1280 -> ~502, 1440 -> ~662, >=1536 -> ~758; without the right column: 768 -> ~654, 1023 -> ~909, 640 -> ~558. So sm:grid-cols-2 is too narrow and a container query is required, not optional. Precedent: @container/roster + @2xl/roster:grid-cols-2 (book-characters-tab.tsx:33, :144)
openDecisions.recommendation: @xl. The uk caption plus the source marker is ~320px wide, so narrower columns wrap one caption and misalign the two 40px boxes; @xl keeps two columns at 1440+, 768-1023 and in tablet widths, and stacks at 1024-1280 with the nav open
openDecisions.answer: @xl container (36rem). Adopted recommendation as a stated assumption: the spec asks to run phases A-D without routine approval pauses.

openDecisions.question: Species D session when focus really leaves the field without a choice (Tab away, click elsewhere)
options: Return to I (same rule as the name field)
Stay in D until Cancel or Escape
openDecisions.specRef: 01_TASK B row 'D species: search, close popup, Tab away or Escape' ('optionally return to I on real focus exit')
openDecisions.facts: Focus-exit can be detected without picker internals: option clicks keep focus in the input (PopoverContent onMouseDown preventDefault, species-picker.tsx:244), keyboard nav is aria-activedescendant, Tab closes the popover (:146-149)
openDecisions.recommendation: Return to I. Two fields with different session rules is a trap for users, and a D left open on a field the user has moved away from shows a main value inside a live picker that is not saved
openDecisions.answer: Return to I on real focus exit, same rule as the name field. Stated assumption (spec marks it optional).

openDecisions.question: Show ManageOwnSpeciesButton under the picker during species D
openDecisions.specRef: 01_TASK A 6A 'preserve catalog/own-species management'; B 'Species identity & dictionary changes'
openDecisions.facts: The button opens a modal dialog (manage-own-species-button.tsx:21-37). Focus moving into the dialog ends D under D2=I, the trigger then unmounts and focus is lost on dialog close. Management stays reachable from the global species field (character-edit-sections.tsx:723)
openDecisions.recommendation: No, keep it O only. With D showing the globalValue prop and no local copy, a dictionary change made from the global field cannot leave a stale value
openDecisions.answer: O only, as today. Stated assumption; management stays reachable from the global species field.

openDecisions.question: What Enter does in the name D editor (the spec only forbids form submission)
options: End the session like blur: explicit value -> O with focus kept in the input, null -> I with focus on the action
openDecisions.specRef: 01_TASK C 'Focus' ('no form submission on Escape/Enter from transient name editor')
openDecisions.facts: Without handling, Enter inside the form's text input submits it (form onSubmit, character-edit-page.tsx:298-301). In O, Enter keeps submitting as today
openDecisions.recommendation: End the session like blur: it gives keyboard users an explicit 'done' that matches Escape = cancel
openDecisions.answer: End the session like blur, with preventDefault so the form never submits. Stated assumption derived from 01_TASK C Focus.
